verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents human-in-the-loop support: the UserProxyAgent lets a human give feedback to the team, AutoGen Studio can pause or stop runs, and community users note it keeps a human in the loop. However, nothing in the evidence shows a mechanism that gates specific sensitive tool calls behind explicit approval before they execute. missing for 10: per-tool approval gating, configuration for marking specific tools as sensitive, a documented approve/deny flow before tool execution, independent hands-on corroboration.
